title: Velocity v1 expression
description: Essential Criteria: The answer must give v1 = 2qBL / ((2+√3)m) or an equivalent simplified form.

title: Time t expression
description: Essential Criteria: The answer must give t = 5πm / (3qB) or an equivalent simplified form.

title: Velocity v3 expression
description: Essential Criteria: The answer must give v3 = 2√3 qBL / (3m) or an equivalent simplified form.

title: Geometry for critical trajectory
description: Important Criteria: For part (1), the solution must correctly relate the chord length L to the radius r1 and the 30° angle, leading to r1 = L / (1 + cos 30°).

title: Centripetal force relation
description: Important Criteria: The solution must apply qvB = mv²/r to relate velocity, radius, and magnetic field for all parts.

title: Time-angle-period relation
description: Important Criteria: For parts (2) and (3), the solution must correctly calculate the time from t = (θ/2π) * T, where T = 2πm/(qB).

title: Angle for v2 trajectory
description: Important Criteria: For part (2), the solution must correctly find the central angle (e.g., 300°) subtended by the arc within the field for velocity v2.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student uses the wrong sign for the charge in the Lorentz force law or misidentifies the direction of deflection.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: The final expressions for v1, t, and v3 should have correct units (e.g., m/s for velocity, seconds for time).
